description: Region set for the pre-registered AquaSentinel backtest (analysis/BACKTEST_PLAN.md). Positives: every NUTS 3 region in Portugal, France, Italy, Belgium or Norway with a first human WNV case date in a cached ECDC season file. Negative controls: the five OAH research-city regions, which have no row in any cached file.

sources.cases: ECDC West Nile virus seasonal tables in data/ecdc/ (docs/SOURCES.md section 9). Dataset provided by ECDC based on data provided by public health authorities, scientific institutes or health care providers in the relevant reporting countries and/or by WHO.
sources.coordinates: Open-Meteo geocoding API https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search (GeoNames data, CC BY 4.0), queried on 2026-09-26 for the administrative seat of each region; first result in the region's country with feature code PPLA, PPLA2 or PPLC, else first result in the country.
